stem: A fracture at the medial epicondyle is followed by weak finger abduction and numbness of the little finger and medial half of the ring finger. Which nerve is injured?

options.label: A
options.explanation: It supplies most thumb opposition and lateral digital sensation, not the described territory.

options.label: B
options.explanation: It supplies wrist and finger extensors and dorsal radial sensation.

options.label: C
options.explanation: It is proximal and supplies the deltoid and lateral shoulder skin.

options.label: D
options.explanation: It supplies the interossei and the medial one-and-a-half digits, matching the motor and sensory findings.

options.label: E
options.explanation: It supplies elbow flexors and lateral forearm sensation.

context: The nerve is exposed behind the medial epicondyle and supplies the interossei and medial hand sensation.
